interval_policy: Reports must label partial intervals by included components. A total prediction interval requires joint propagation of every applicable component and may not be replaced by a best-fit trace.

components.name: measurement
components.method: Use source-specific sensor, meter, sampling, and missing-data uncertainty from the registered dataset manifest.
components.evidence: No measurement series is used in the Phase 4.27 analytical RC fixture.
components.calibration_gate: Block empirical fitting until variable-level measurement uncertainty or a documented conservative fallback is frozen.

components.name: weather_input
components.method: Perturb aligned weather fields using registered source uncertainty while preserving radiation and temporal consistency.
components.evidence: The RC sensitivity fixture uses prescribed deterministic forcing; no weather accuracy claim is made.
components.calibration_gate: Block empirical credibility claims until weather/input uncertainty is propagated.

components.name: parameter
components.method: A deterministic 512-sample clipped-normal ensemble reports a 95 percent parameter-only temperature interval.
components.calibration_gate: Replace illustrative distributions with justified priors or fitted covariance before empirical reporting.

components.name: structural_model
components.method: Compare supported model structures and analyze systematic residuals by regime.
components.evidence: The one-node fixture verifies one declared reduced-order structure only.
components.calibration_gate: Do not interpret parameter uncertainty as structural uncertainty.

components.name: numerical
components.method: Compare the 15-minute production timestep against a one-minute reference and report RMSE and maximum absolute temperature error.
components.calibration_gate: Repeat convergence analysis at every empirical study timestep.

components.name: stochastic_occupant
components.method: Use repeated fixed-seed ensembles and between-person variability intervals for occupant-enabled studies.
components.evidence: The Phase 4.27 RC fixture contains deterministic scheduled gains and no stochastic occupant model.
components.calibration_gate: Mandatory for occupant-enabled calibration; not applicable to this deterministic analytical fixture.
